dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicare Advantage organizations, researchers, health entities, and enrollees receiving supplemental benefits.
dimensions.evidence: a contract under this section with an MA organization shall require the organization to submit to the Secretary... enrollee-level data on supplemental benefits

dimensions.assessment: Changes data reporting and transparency requirements for health plans without directly altering the underlying benefits provided to enrollees.
dimensions.evidence: increase data transparency for supplemental benefits under Medicare Advantage

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending or revenue changes are stated in the source text.
Amends Section 1857(e) of the Social Security Act to add new mandatory data reporting and public data file publication rules.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1857(e) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395w-27(e)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent reporting requirement beginning with plan years on or after January 1, 2029.
dimensions.evidence: Beginning with plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2029

missing_information: Administrative costs to Medicare Advantage plans for collecting and submitting enrollee-level data.
Exact procedures the Secretary will use to safeguard enrollee privacy.
importance_detail.rationale: Amends the Social Security Act to require Medicare Advantage organizations to submit enrollee-level data on supplemental benefits, which the Secretary must make available to researchers and the public.
